name: Batch-Instance Norm
tagline: Per-channel learnable gate that interpolates between BatchNorm and InstanceNorm statistics.
diff_from_baseline: Nam & Kim 2018 (NeurIPS). Batch-Instance Normalization for adaptively style-invariant networks: gates BN and IN per channel; ρ→1 recovers BatchNorm, ρ→0 recovers InstanceNorm.

name: GroupNorm
tagline: Splits channels into G groups and normalizes within each group; independent of batch size.
diff_from_baseline: Wu & He 2018 (ECCV). Group Normalization: avoids batch dependency by normalizing within channel groups; standard fallback for small-batch CNNs.

name: Switchable Norm
tagline: Softmax-weighted convex combination of BatchNorm, InstanceNorm, and LayerNorm statistics with learnable importance weights.

key_hyperparams.name: mean_weight
key_hyperparams.role: logits for {IN, LN, BN} mean mix

key_hyperparams.name: var_weight
key_hyperparams.role: logits for {IN, LN, BN} variance mix

diff_from_baseline: Luo et al. 2019 (ICLR). Differentiable Learning-to-Normalize via Switchable Normalization: softmax-weighted mix over BN/IN/LN statistics with separately learned mean and variance weights.
